news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis and reported alignment on the planned submission strategy, content and format. The company confirmed it remains on track to submit its first NDA by Q4 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Abivax S.A. (ABVX.US) With Buy Rating, Raises Target Price to $180
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated its Overweight/Buy rating on Abivax and raised its price target from $132 to $180. The upgrade reflects growing analyst confidence in obefazimod's regulatory and commercial trajectory following the positive FDA pre-NDA outcome.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders -- covering marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access/pricing -- including a former Amgen TEZSPIRE and long-time Takeda ENTYVIO executive as Global Head of Marketing. The hires build out the organization ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential US launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC that the newly raised $920 million gives Abivax cash into late 2029 and the option to build US launch infrastructure for obefazimod without a Big Pharma partner. Responding to ongoing takeover speculation, he said "the best defense for us is actually the offense."

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an upsized public offering of 7.36 million ADSs after underwriters fully exercised their option, generating gross proceeds of about $920 million (net ~$874.1 million). Proceeds are earmarked for potential US commercialization of obefazimod and ongoing clinical R&D in ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod, Demonstrating Meaningful Clinical Benefit in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 maintenance data showed 37.2% of prior induction non-responders on 50mg obefazimod achieved clinical remission at Week 44, with roughly 45% of relapsed patients recapturing remission via dose escalation or re-treatment. The results expanded the safety and efficacy database in a more refractory UC population ahead of the planned FDA filing.

catalysts.label: NDA Submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis to the FDA, following a positive pre-NDA meeting outcome.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA)
catalysts.detail: Abivax intends to submit a MAA to the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, contingent on the completed positive Phase 3 maintenance dataset.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 Financial Results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results and a business update.

catalysts.label: Lead Combination Therapy Candidate Selection
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to select a lead obefazimod combination candidate (paired with an IL-23, a4b7, PDE-4 or AhR mechanism) to advance into development.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's Disease Induction Data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease is expected, though company-guided timing has shifted between late 2026 and mid-2027 across recent communications.

catalysts.label: Potential US Commercial Launch of Obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Contingent on FDA approval after the Q4 2026 NDA filing, Abivax has built a commercial leadership team in preparation for a potential solo US launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis.

pulse: Abivax enters mid-August 2026 on a run of strong momentum: a positive July 30 FDA pre-NDA meeting confirmed the company is on track to file its first NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis by Q4 2026, backed by a freshly closed $920 million equity raise (cash runway into late 2029) and a newly assembled US commercial leadership team. Persistent Big Pharma takeover speculation (Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca) continues to swirl around the stock, even as CEO Marc de Garidel emphasizes a preference to pursue a solo US launch from a position of financial strength. With an EMA filing also targeted for H2 2026, Wall Street sentiment remains bullish (Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $180 in late July), while Crohn's disease (ENHANCE-CD) data remains a longer-dated, less certain catalyst.
